text.tspan: Hyundai/Kia
M-CAN to OBD dongle
Name:
Tyler Harvey
Drawn by:
Date:
Drawing Number:
HKMOBD_SHR_ES_CMP-010
1. all wire connections crimped
2. all connectors to oem spec as in drawing C-2188701 and SD-51115-001
3. all crimping for 2188701 and male mate connectors according to spec 411-61029
4. all crimping for 51115-1611 according to spec in drawing SD-51115-001
5. wrap all wires in automotive cloth tape wrap to 30mm from connectors
5. a) wrap all W3 wires (W3_a, W3_b, W3_c) in one sleeve
b) wrap all W2 wires (W2_a-W2_h) and W1 wires (W1_a, W1_b) in one sleeve
c) place shunt within 100mm from OBD port
6. alternative connectors are acceptable for shunt as long as they maintain 9mm separation
between M-CAN_(HIGH) and M-CAN_(LOW)
7. do not short together two wires not explicitly indicated as connected without further discussion
8. wire lengths should match past revisions except as indicated: +0.05m on W2_a, W2_b_twisted,
W2_c_twisted.
9. any splice type suitable for long-term automotive applications is acceptable
10. substitution of parts for cost is acceptable as long as replacements meet original specification
11. wire colors are for clarity and not required
12. all twisted pairs (W2_b, W2_c, W3_c) twisted at 40 twists per meter
